verdict.rationale: The docs suggest "Explain this repo." as a first prompt, with no file selection, and state that in plan mode the agent explores the codebase on its own. That shows the agent gathers its own context for repo-level explanation. However, the evidence is only a sample prompt and one line on exploration, with no detail on how the codebase is mapped. Missing for 10: documented codebase mapping or indexing (structure overviews, architecture maps), depth of whole-repo explanation, and independent hands-on corroboration of the quality of repo explanations.

support.subject: As a developer, I can have the agent map and explain an entire unfamiliar codebase without manually selecting context files

citations.quote: Useful first prompts: Explain this repo.
In plan mode the agent explores the codebase and drafts a plan for your approval before it edits anything.
